events.name: Red Nova
events.info: Red NovaPrepare your ears for Red Nova, Honolulus fiery, open-flow free jazz trio that hurls musical safety nets straight out the window! Fronted by the fearlessly creative lineup of Peter Shaindlin soaring on trumpet and flugelhorn, Randy Wong anchoring the low end on acoustic bass, and Jay Jaskot driving the pulse on percussion, this power trio creates pure sonic magic live on stage. Playing completely unscripted, improvised sets without key signatures or guardrails, they turn every performanceincluding high-profile residencies at legendary venues like Blue Note Hawaiiinto an adrenaline-fueled exploration of sound. Their critically acclaimed debut live album, Presence of Mind, recorded at Hawaii Public Radios Atherton Studio, earned well-deserved Nā Hōkū Hanohano Award nominations, proving that wild, cutting-edge experimentation can capture hearts and accolades alike. Ready to dive into the avant-garde deep end? events.name: Justin Kawika Young
events.info: Justin Kawika YoungThere are artists who chase moments. And then there are artists who write them down before they disappear. For nearly three decades, Justin Kawika Young has been doing the latter. His music carries an honesty that has quietly found its way into peoples lives. Weddings. Long drives. Breakups. Reunions. The spaces in between.Over the years, his music has traveled under different names Justin, Justin Young, and now Justin Kawika Young but the heart behind it has never changed. A warm voice. A storytellers instinct. Songs that feel more like conversations than performances.Tickets $25-$35__________________________________________CLUB POLICIESShow 7pmDoors 5pmSeating is First Come, First Served Per Section$20 Minimum Per PersonFull Bar & Dinner Menu AvailableNO REFUNDS OR EXCHANGES.Tickets will be delivered 48 hours prior to the showtime.Please ensure you purchase tickets for the correct date and time.When all available Bar Seats are occupied, the remaining Bar Area is standing room only. events.name: Mike Lewis Big Band
events.info: Mike Lewis Big Band Local trumpeter and bandleader Mike Lewis returns to the club with his 17-piece big band! Now in his 11th year of Big Band Monday Residency at Blue Note Hawaii, Mike Lewis caps his illustrious 55th round the world show biz career trumpeting with the best; Tony Bennett, Billy Joel, Frank Sinatra, Sarah Vaughn, Wynton Marsalis, Sammy Davis and even Hawaiʻi's own Kalapana, C&K and Bruno Mars to name just a few. Recent recipient of The Hawaiʻi State Senate honorarium for "his signature sound, dynamic conducting, and masterful arrangements. Mike Lewis has built and sustained Hawaiʻi's vibrant big band community" Mike also holds the record for the most shows performed and produced at Blue Note Hawaii.
